description:
Adjust the system permissions for the Flight Crew View app to improve flight tracking and privacy. 

Starting from the app:
1. Navigate to Android System Settings > Apps > Flight Crew View > Permissions.
2. Change the **Location** permission to '**Allow all the time**' (currently set to 'Allow only while using the app').
3. Change the **Microphone** permission to '**Don't allow**' (currently Allowed).
4. Ensure Calendar and Contacts permissions remain Allowed.
5. Return to the Flight Crew View app and ensure the Friends page is visible.

Note: You may need to go to the Home screen to find Settings.
